summary: Session 3 of 4 - Parser stack and symbol DB review (read-only discovery; no shipping code changed). Authored s3-review-findings.md: 10 findings (1 Critical proven: F-3-1 the manifest pipeline parses raw SaveAsText form/report dumps whole-file as VBA, so the committed HomeHealthCare golden ships 0/19 forms and 0/12 reports with any parsed VBA items, silently - the parse diagnostics are discarded at Pipeline.cs:307; 4 Major: F-3-2 AstBuilder NullReferenceExceptions on legal VBA (typed procedure names 'Function SqlStr$()' crash directly; 'Dim step As String' - accepted by Access's own VBE, proven by the committed fixture - crashes via recovery cascade; reproduced the golden's basResetFixture failure and bisected the trigger), F-3-3 type-suffix asymmetry (module vars/consts/params keep the $%&!#@ suffix in declaration Name while references strip it - probe-proven unresolvable; locals handled correctly), F-3-4 the resolver's differentiating capabilities have zero production call sites (AccessObjectModelRegistry/default members/type inference/dynamic SQL/SQL form references; manifest path builds a fresh per-module ProjectScope so even cross-module resolution is dead, while SymbolDb wires it correctly; SqlStrings hardcoded empty), F-3-5 explicit ByVal never emitted in ParserOutput signatures (proven end-to-end in the golden against the documented omission convention); plus 4 Minor (diagnostics/reasons dropped at manifest layer; crosstab TRANSFORM parses cleanly but its parse knowledge is discarded and Parsed.QueryType re-stamps the broken DAO decode - answers Session 2's carry-forward: the jet parser IS fit as the contract-grade type source; emission-time name heuristics fabricate EventHandler bindings and label class modules 'Form'; the expected.json 'contract' is enforced as schema-shape only with README drift) and 1 Observation bundle. Hermetic baseline green: 917 tests across 5 parser-stack projects. Cross-provider verification (gpt-5-4): round 1 ISSUES_FOUND (3 Minor findings-doc discipline issues), fixed and persisted to s3-issues.json; round 2 VERIFIED with 0 issues.
